values.note: A single roadside site, 005, Blue Hole Division of Forbes State Forest, on Cole Run Road (via Trent, Barron Church and Gary Roads from Route 31 at Bakersville). Back-In, max vehicle length 25 ft; site pad 75 x 15 ft with a 110-ft gravel driveway, 20-ft overhead clearance, partial shade. All equipment must fit on the site pad; no more than 2 vehicles.

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880267&siteId=29384 ('Max Vehicle Length: 25', 'Driveway Entry: Back-In', 'Driveway Surface: Gravel', 'Driveway Length: 110', 'Site Length: 75', 'Site Width: 15'; Site Limitations), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Open April 2 to the last day of the regular rifle deer season (ReserveAmerica shows 'Open through Fri Dec 11 2026'); closed for winter, and forest roads are not plowed.

season.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/forbes/camping ('Motorized, roadside campsites are available from April 2 to last day of regular rifle deer season'; 'Forbes State Forest campsites are closed for the winter season from the last day of regular rifle deer season to April 2 annually') + https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880267&siteId=29384 ('Status: Open through Fri Dec 11 2026'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: A permit and reservation are always required; reserve online or at 888-PA-PARKS. Forbes asks campers to take no more than one permit a month. Check-in and check-out 3 pm; campers must vacate for at least 48 hours before returning.

booking.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/forbes/camping ('Camping permits and reservations are required to stay at motorized, roadside campsites', 'may be reserved up to eleven months in advance', 'Stays are limited to seven nights at a motorized, roadside campsite', 'please obtain no more than one permit per month', 'Campers must vacate for at least 48 hours before returning') + https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880267&siteId=29384 ('Site Reserve Type: Site-Specific'); noon cutoff as recorded from the DCNR motorized roadside camping page, read 2026-10-20

summary: Matched to ReserveAmerica site 005, Blue Hole Division by coordinates. Confirmed reservable on ReserveAmerica 11 months ahead, 7-night limit. Added no hookups/water/dump/showers, a single back-in roadside site with a 25-ft max vehicle length, reservation always required (fcfs never), season April 2 to the end of rifle deer season, one-permit-a-month request. Fees left at the DCNR state forest rate.
